rappel_detail.station: The mid-height station on the west side.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 2 of 3, to a ledge. Move right along the ledge.

rappel_detail.station: The ledge, after moving right along it.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 3 of 3, down pitch 1’s north face to the Liberty Bell-Concord notch.

set.rappels: 3 rappels on a single 60 m rope: two down the summit’s west side, breaking at the mid-height station (two ropes make it one), then one down pitch 1’s north face to the notch
